title: Union of India v. Indo-Afghan Agencies Ltd.

content.caseIdentity: Union of India v. Indo-Afghan Agencies Ltd., (1968) 2 SCR 366
content.facts: The Government made representations concerning import entitlements under an export-promotion scheme.
questionsBeforeCourt: Can the Government be held to a representation on which citizens rely?
content.ratioDecidendi: Government is not exempt from the public-law consequences of a representation made as to future conduct merely because the representation concerns governmental policy.
content.holding: The Court enforced the governmental representation in the circumstances.
content.relevance: Use as an early foundation of promissory estoppel against government.
